zh_cn.message.piq_fc_arcade.zapper_stand_chang: 设备或物品状态已改变，请重试。
zh_cn.message.piq_fc_arcade.zapper_stand_empty: 支架为空：手持一把光枪右键放入。
zh_cn.message.piq_fc_arcade.zapper_stand_borro: 原光枪已取走；请将同一把枪带回支架。
zh_cn.message.piq_fc_arcade.zapper_stand_power: 请先连接支架与 FC，再按主机电源开机后取枪。
zh_cn.message.piq_fc_arcade.zapper_stand_taken: 已取出原光枪；输入授权或加入审批已提交。归还支架不会结束本局。
zh_cn.message.piq_fc_arcade.zapper_stand_take_: 原枪已取出，但未取得输入权限；请检查主机是否为光枪局，或先归还支架。
zh_cn.message.piq_fc_arcade.zapper_stand_use_g: 空手取枪；手持原光枪放回。连接请使用光枪连接线。
zh_cn.message.piq_fc_arcade.zapper_stand_full: 支架上已有一把枪，不能再放入。
zh_cn.message.piq_fc_arcade.zapper_stand_wrong: 这不是本支架借出的唯一原枪，无法放回。
zh_cn.message.piq_fc_arcade.zapper_stand_retur: 原光枪已放回，输入已释放；本局继续运行。
zh_cn.message.piq_fc_arcade.zapper_stand_denie: 两端都需在使用范围内，且有操作权限。
zh_cn.message.piq_fc_arcade.zapper_stand_disco: 支架已断线，光枪输入已撤销。
zh_cn.message.piq_fc_arcade.zapper_stand_busy: 连接操作繁忙，请稍后重试。
zh_cn.message.piq_fc_arcade.zapper_stand_selec: 已选支架；60 秒内右键同维度 16 格内的 FC 主机连接。潜行右键支架断线。
请先用光枪连接线右键支架，再右键 FC 主机。
zh_cn.message.piq_fc_arcade.zapper_stand_fc_on: 光枪支架只连接 FC 主机，不能连接电视、SFC 或街机。
zh_cn.message.piq_fc_arcade.zapper_stand_stop_: 请先关闭主机，再连接光枪支架；不在运行中切换核心。
zh_cn.message.piq_fc_arcade.zapper_stand_alrea: 两端已有连接，或达到 128 组上限；请先断开旧连接。
zh_cn.message.piq_fc_arcade.zapper_stand_conne: 支架已连接 FC；先放入原光枪，再按主机电源开机取枪。

en_us.message.piq_fc_arcade.zapper_stand_chang: Device or item changed; please try again.
en_us.message.piq_fc_arcade.zapper_stand_empty: Empty stand: right-click while holding a Zapper to dock it.
en_us.message.piq_fc_arcade.zapper_stand_borro: The original gun is borrowed. Bring that same gun back.
en_us.message.piq_fc_arcade.zapper_stand_power: Connect this stand to FC, then switch the console on before taking the gun.
en_us.message.piq_fc_arcade.zapper_stand_taken: Original gun taken; input authorization or join approval requested. Returning it keeps the game running.
en_us.message.piq_fc_arcade.zapper_stand_take_: Gun taken without input authority. Check for a running Zapper session, or return the gun.
en_us.message.piq_fc_arcade.zapper_stand_use_g: Empty hand: take gun. Held original gun: return. Use a Zapper cable to connect.
en_us.message.piq_fc_arcade.zapper_stand_full: This stand already contains a gun.
en_us.message.piq_fc_arcade.zapper_stand_wrong: This is not the unique original gun borrowed from this stand.
en_us.message.piq_fc_arcade.zapper_stand_retur: Gun returned and input released. The game keeps running.
en_us.message.piq_fc_arcade.zapper_stand_denie: Both endpoints must be within reach and permitted.
en_us.message.piq_fc_arcade.zapper_stand_busy: Connection service is busy; try again.
en_us.message.piq_fc_arcade.zapper_stand_selec: Stand selected. Within 60 seconds, click an FC console within 16 blocks in this dimension. Crouch-click stand to disconnect.
Use the Zapper cable on the stand first, then on an FC console.
en_us.message.piq_fc_arcade.zapper_stand_fc_on: Zapper stands connect to FC consoles only, not TVs, SFC or arcade cabinets.
en_us.message.piq_fc_arcade.zapper_stand_stop_: Switch the console off before connecting. Never switch emulator type during play.
en_us.message.piq_fc_arcade.zapper_stand_alrea: An endpoint is already connected, or the 128-link limit was reached. Disconnect the old link first.
en_us.message.piq_fc_arcade.zapper_stand_conne: Stand connected. Dock an existing gun, switch the console on, then take the gun.
